title: Machines on Machines newsletter launch on the unified system
description:
**Goal.** Machines on Machines launches its newsletter directly on the unified system: weekly cadence, Ryan as the sole approver, and signup opens only after deliverability readiness passes.

**Build.** Enable the notifications plugin on MoM with a public roundup kind (weekly), Story types declared for articles, sole approver Ryan, sending identity `mail.machines-on-machines.anth.us` (PPY-c522bf). The signup placements stay hidden until the readiness check passes; then they appear in one deploy together with the subscribe and manage pages. Outward-facing sends: the first issue and every issue need Ryan's explicit approval; no automated send.

**Specification.**
```gherkin
Feature: Machines on Machines newsletter
  Scenario: Signup closed until ready
    Given deliverability readiness has not passed
    Then no signup form or subscribe page link is shown on the site

  Scenario: Signup opens
    When the readiness check passes
    Then signup placements appear and a confirmed reader joins the weekly roundup

  Scenario: Living weekly issue
    When the weekly period begins (Monday 04:00 in the America/New_York publication zone)
    Then that period's issue Story is created automatically and fills with qualifying three-star articles through the week
    And Ryan is told when it is ready to approve

  Scenario: Send time across daylight saving
    Given the weekly send is Monday 04:00 America/New_York
    When the clocks change in spring or autumn
    Then the issue still goes out at 04:00 local time on Monday, stored as UTC and shown in the publication zone

  Scenario: Sole approver
    When anyone but Ryan tries to approve
    Then it is refused

  Scenario: First send
    Given Ryan approved the first issue
    Then it goes to the warm-up cohort only, then widens by the warm-up plan
```

**Depends on:** public audiences, ownership, issue kind, selection, Analytics events, deliverability readiness.
**Related:** PPY-31455f.

**Answered (Ryan, 2026-11-12):** (1) The weekly send is Monday 04:00 Eastern for now, and it may change. The zone is America/New_York; the scheduler works in the publication time zone, handles daylight saving there, stores the time as UTC and shows it in the publication zone (umbrella decisions). The send time is list configuration, not code. Still blocked by the DMARC task PPY-6bcae9.

**Open questions for Ryan:** (1) Do the first subscribers come only from the site, or also a list you hold?
